pieces.Text: A witch killer can detect arcane magic by scent. He can use detect magic at will (as per a paladin's ability to detect evil), but only against arcane magic, and the ability is scent-based and thus defeated by effects like negate aroma. Even when he isn't concentrating on using his magic scent, when a creature within scent range casts an arcane spell (including arcane spell-like abilities or magic item effects), the witch killer automatically pinpoints the caster's location.
